title: Quantum Fisher Information for Entropy of Gibbs States
summary: We derive the quantum Fisher information for entropy estimation in a Gibbs state and show that it equals the inverse of the heat capacity, which is dual to the temperature Fisher information given by the heat capacity divided by the square of the temperature. Their product is independent of the Hamiltonian and depends only on the temperature, leading to a metrological uncertainty relation between the variances of entropy and temperature estimators in which all system-specific quantities cancel.
